review:
An Asian-style 5x3 classic with a lot packed in: three bonus games, a three-pot coin system and three jackpots.

Three or more yin-yang symbols open free spins with either a giant symbol or only high symbols in play, and extra bonus symbols extend the round. Six gold coins start a coin round where the pots and collect coins grow your wins. Medium-low volatility, 2,000x max and 95.05% RTP, with free spins about once every 206 spins. Lots of variety for a classic.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
